crossRefs.note: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring…

parallels.note: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

translations.web: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
